newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market slow - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, USDA said. Trade was slow with demand and seller interest light, offerings light.
Confirmed Sales: 400 Week Ago: 5,600 Year Ago: 10,000
Week to Date: 25,900 Week Ago: 13,400 Year Ago: 25,500
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs few 65.00
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales
Carcass Basis (weight only): slaughter steers & heifers were not fully established.
Holstein: (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 100.00-102.00
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100 lbs few 106.00
For the week: 28,000 Wk ago: 13,400 Yr ago: 25,500
Live basis: 2.00-3.00 lower. Carcass basis: 4.00 lower.
